node.title: Re: Win32:OLE MS-Word comment bubbles
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Pretty much all of VBA can be translated to [mod://Win32::OLE] calls, so you can use Microsoft's VBA documentation. Some quick Googling brings me to the [https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/office/vba/api/word.document.deleteallcomments|Document.DeleteAllComments method], and this works for me:

use Win32::OLE; my $Word = Win32::OLE->GetActiveObject('Word.Application'); $Word->{ActiveDocument}->DeleteAllComments;
